none: PAS LIN-79CAB5: LIN-79CAB5: silver Roman 'TOT' finger ring
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete silver Roman 'TOT' finger ring (AD c.100-c.300), missing fragments from the edges of its shoulders, the ring is torn in places and bent. The shape and style of the ring fall into Henig type VIII. Overall, the ring measures 22.71 mm long, 23.63 mm wide and 3.03 mm thick. It weighs 4.06g.
